selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Direct pre- and post-restart output shows the persistent file and all relevant runtime sysctls set to 0.
Captured original boot ID, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, observed a changed boot ID, and verified system_state=running, failed_units=0, and persisted hardening after recovery.

commands.command:
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'uptime_seconds='; cut -d. -f1 /proc/uptime; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true; sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; printf '%s
' 'per-interface values:'; for d in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do i=${d##*/}; printf '%s redirects=%s source_route=%s
' "$i" "$(cat "$d/accept_redirects")" "$(cat "$d/accept_source_route")"; done; printf '%s
' 'existing persistent declarations:'; grep -RnsE '^[[:space:]]*net\.ipv4\.conf\.(all|default)\.(accept_redirects|accept_source_route)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d /usr/lib/sysctl.d /run/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true
